requirements.section: Part II-A Chapter 2 - Noxious liquid substances
requirements.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirements.sourceText: In Arctic waters any discharge into the sea of noxious liquid substances (NLS), or mixtures containing such substances, shall be prohibited.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: polar-operation coverage in NLS documents
requirements.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF ship_operates_in_polar_waters = true, THEN polar_operation_coverage shall be present in the applicable Cargo Record Book, Manual, and NLS or marine pollution emergency plan.
requirements.requiredInputs: Applicable MARPOL Annex II documents and coverage indicators
requirements.section: Part II-A Chapter 2 - Noxious liquid substances
requirements.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirements.sourceText: Operation in polar waters shall be taken into account, as appropriate, in the Cargo Record Book, the Manual and the shipboard marine pollution emergency plan for noxious liquid substances or the shipboard marine pollution emergency plan as required by MARPOL Annex II.

requirements.anchorMapField: iceClass -> reg:iceClass; No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: NLS classification, cargo-tank type and approval/certificate properties
requirements.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF ship_category IN {'A','B'} AND construction_date >= '2017-01-01' AND carried_NLS_requires_type_3_tank = true AND cargo_tank_type = 3, THEN administration_carriage_approval_status = approved AND applicable_certificate_polar_operation_entry_present = true.
requirements.requiredInputs: Ship/cargo/tank particulars, Administration approval, and certificate entry
requirements.section: Part II-A Chapter 2 - Noxious liquid substances
requirements.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirements.sourceText: For category A and B ships constructed on or after 1 January 2017, the carriage of NLS identified in chapter 17, column e, as ship type 3 or identified as NLS in chapter 18 of the International Code for the Construction and Equipment of Ships Carrying Dangerous Chemicals in Bulk, in cargo tanks of type 3 ships shall be subject to the approval of the Administration. The results shall be reflected on the International Pollution Prevention Certificate for the Carriage of Noxious Liquid Substances in Bulk or Certificate of Fitness identifying the operation in polar waters.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: sewage discharge and distance/ice-concentration properties
requirements.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF sewage_discharge_type = comminuted_and_disinfected, THEN MARPOL_IV_11_1_1_compliance_status = compliant AND distance_to_nearest_ice_shelf_or_fast_ice_nm > 3; record distance from areas with ice_concentration_tenths > 1.
requirements.requiredInputs: Discharge type, MARPOL compliance, position, and ice-condition data
requirements.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirements.sourceText: The ship is discharging comminuted and disinfected sewage in accordance with regulation 11.1.1 of MARPOL Annex IV at a distance of more than three nautical miles from any ice-shelf or fast ice and shall be as far as practicable from areas of ice concentration exceeding 1/10.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: sewage discharge and distance/ice-concentration properties
requirements.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF sewage_discharge_type = not_comminuted_or_disinfected, THEN MARPOL_IV_11_1_1_compliance_status = compliant AND distance_to_nearest_ice_shelf_or_fast_ice_nm > 12; record distance from areas with ice_concentration_tenths > 1.
requirements.requiredInputs: Discharge type, MARPOL compliance, position, and ice-condition data
requirements.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirements.sourceText: The ship is discharging sewage that is not comminuted or disinfected in accordance with regulation 11.1.1 of MARPOL Annex IV and at a distance of more than 12 nautical miles from any ice-shelf or fast ice and shall be as far as practicable from areas of ice concentration exceeding 1/10.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: sewage-treatment approval/compliance and distance properties
requirements.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF sewage_discharge_uses_treatment_plant = true, THEN sewage_treatment_plant_approval_status = approved, MARPOL_IV_9_1_1_or_9_2_1_certification_status = compliant, MARPOL_IV_11_1_2_discharge_status = compliant, and distances to land, ice shelf, fast ice, and ice concentration greater than 1/10 shall be recorded.
requirements.requiredInputs: Treatment-plant certificate, MARPOL compliance evidence, and discharge position/ice data
requirements.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirements.sourceText: The ship has in operation an approved sewage treatment plant certified by the Administration to meet the operational requirements in either regulation 9.1.1 or 9.2.1 of MARPOL Annex IV, and discharges sewage in accordance with regulation 11.1.2 of Annex IV and shall be as far as practicable from the nearest land, any ice-shelf, fast ice or areas of ice concentration exceeding 1/10.

requirements.anchorMapField: iceClass -> reg:iceClass; No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: construction date, ship type and sewage-discharge properties
requirements.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF construction_date >= '2017-01-01' AND (ship_category IN {'A','B'} OR ship_type = passenger_ship), THEN sewage_discharge_to_sea = false UNLESS clause_4_2_1_3_compliance_status = compliant.
requirements.requiredInputs: Ship particulars, discharge record, and treatment-plant option compliance
requirements.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirements.sourceText: Discharge of sewage into the sea from category A and B ships constructed on or after 1 January 2017 and all passenger ships constructed on or after 1 January 2017 is prohibited, except when such discharges are in compliance with paragraph 4.2.1.3 of this chapter.

requirements.anchorMapField: iceClass -> reg:iceClass; No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: ice concentration and sewage-treatment approval properties
requirements.canonicalVariables: ship_category, ice_concentration_tenths, extended_period_operation, sewage_discharge_occurs, approved_sewage_treatment_plant_used, MARPOL_certification_status, administration_discharge_approval_status
requirements.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF ship_category IN {'A','B'} AND ice_concentration_tenths > 1 AND extended_period_operation = true AND sewage_discharge_occurs = true, THEN approved_sewage_treatment_plant_used = true, MARPOL_IV_9_1_1_or_9_2_1_certification_status = compliant, and administration_discharge_approval_status = approved.
requirements.requiredInputs: Ship category, operating ice data, treatment-plant certificate, and discharge approval
requirements.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirements.sourceText: Category A and B ships that operate in areas of ice concentrations exceeding 1/10 for extended periods of time, may only discharge sewage using an approved sewage treatment plant certified by the Administration to meet the operational requirements in regulation 9.1.1 or 9.2.1 of MARPOL Annex IV. Such discharges shall be subject to approval by the Administration.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: food-waste discharge and distance/ice-concentration properties
requirements.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF operating_area = Arctic_waters AND food_waste_discharge_to_sea = true, THEN distance_to_nearest_land_ice_shelf_or_fast_ice_nm >= 12 and the distance from areas with ice_concentration_tenths > 1 shall be recorded.
requirements.requiredInputs: Discharge record, position, nearest-feature distances, and ice data
requirements.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirements.sourceText: Discharge into the sea of food wastes is only permitted when the ship is as far as practicable from areas of ice concentration exceeding 1/10, but in any case not less than 12 nautical miles from the nearest land, nearest ice-shelf, or nearest fast ice.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: food-waste processing and screen-opening properties
requirements.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF food_waste_discharge_to_sea = true, THEN food_waste_comminuted_or_ground = true, required_screen_opening_mm <= 25, and contaminated_by_other_garbage = false.
requirements.requiredInputs: Food-waste processing record, screen specification, and contamination status
requirements.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirements.sourceText: Food wastes shall be comminuted or ground and shall be capable of passing through a screen with openings no greater than 25 mm. Food wastes shall not be contaminated by any other garbage type.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: food-waste and animal-carcass discharge properties
requirements.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirements.normalizedRequirement: food_waste_discharge_onto_ice = false AND animal_carcass_discharge = false.
requirements.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirements.sourceText: Food wastes shall not be discharged onto the ice; discharge of animal carcasses is prohibited.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: cargo-residue discharge-condition properties
requirements.canonicalVariables: residue_not_recoverable_by_common_methods, ship_en_route, harmful_substance_present, departure_and_destination_within_Arctic, route_remains_within_Arctic, adequate_reception_facilities_available, distance_to_nearest_land_ice_shelf_or_fast_ice_nm, nearby_ice_concentration_tenths
requirements.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirements.normalizedRequirement: Cargo-residue discharge is permitted only if residue_not_recoverable_by_common_methods = true, ship_en_route = true, harmful_substance_present = false, departure_and_destination_within_Arctic = true, route_remains_within_Arctic = true, adequate_reception_facilities_available = false, and distance_to_nearest_land_ice_shelf_or_fast_ice_nm >= 12; record distance from ice concentration greater than 1/10.
requirements.requiredInputs: Cargo/cleaning-agent classification, voyage route, reception-facility status, and discharge position/ice data
requirements.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirements.sourceText: Discharge of cargo residues that cannot be recovered using commonly available methods for unloading shall only be permitted while the ship is en route and where all of the following conditions are satisfied: cargo residues, cleaning agents or additives, contained in hold washing water do not include any substances classified as harmful to the marine environment; both the port of departure and the next port of destination are within Arctic waters and the ship will not transit outside Arctic waters between those ports; no adequate reception facilities are available at those ports; and discharge of cargo hold washing water containing residues shall be made as far as practicable from areas of ice concentration exceeding 1/10, but in any case not less than 12 nautical miles from the nearest land, nearest ice shelf, or nearest fast ice.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: Antarctic discharge-distance and food-waste properties
requirements.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF operating_area = Antarctic_area AND MARPOL_V_6_1_discharge = true, THEN distance_to_nearest_fast_ice_nm >= 12 and the distance from areas with ice_concentration_tenths > 1 shall be recorded; food_waste_discharge_onto_ice = false.
requirements.requiredInputs: Operating area, discharge record, position/ice data, and food-waste event type
requirements.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirements.sourceText: In the Antarctic area, discharges under regulation 6.1 of MARPOL Annex V shall be as far as practicable from areas of ice concentration exceeding 1/10, but in any case not less than 12 nautical miles from the nearest fast ice; and food waste shall not be discharged onto ice.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: polar-operation coverage in garbage documents
requirements.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF ship_operates_in_polar_waters = true, THEN polar_operation_coverage shall be present in the applicable Garbage Record Book, Garbage Management Plan, and garbage placards.
requirements.requiredInputs: Applicable MARPOL Annex V documents and placards
requirements.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirements.sourceText: Operation in polar waters shall be taken into account, as appropriate, in the Garbage Record Book, Garbage Management Plan and the placards as required by MARPOL Annex V.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: SOLAS_chapter_I_certified, chapter_9_applicable

requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: This chapter applies to ships certified in accordance with SOLAS chapter I.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: ship type, dimensions, trade status and chapter applicability
requirements.normalizedRequirement: chapter_9_1_applicable = true IF (ship_type = fishing_vessel AND length_overall_m >= 24) OR (ship_type = pleasure_yacht AND gross_tonnage >= 300 AND engaged_in_trade = false) OR (ship_type = cargo_ship AND 300 <= gross_tonnage < 500).
requirements.requiredInputs: Ship type, length overall, gross tonnage, and trade status
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: This chapter applies to: fishing vessels of 24 metres in length overall and above; pleasure yachts of 300 gross tonnage and upwards not engaged in trade; and cargo ships of 300 gross tonnage and upwards but below 500 gross tonnage.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: chapter 9-1 information-receiving capabilities
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF chapter_9_1_applicable = true, THEN current_navigation_information_receiving_capability = true AND current_ice_information_receiving_capability = true.
requirements.requiredInputs: Applicability and navigation/ice information feed capability
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: Ships shall have the ability to receive up-to-date information including ice information for safe navigation.

requirements.activeStatus: Evidence-only - physical result not inferred by SHACL
requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: navigation equipment and environmental-functionality test properties
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF chapter_9_1_applicable = true, THEN every navigation equipment item shall have environmental_functionality_test_status = passed for the expected operating-area conditions.
requirements.requiredInputs: Equipment inventory, operating-area conditions, and test records
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: The navigational equipment and systems shall be designed, constructed and installed to retain their functionality under the expected environmental conditions in the area of operation.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: heading/position system and intended-area suitability properties
requirements.normalizedRequirement: Every heading-reference and position-fixing system shall have intended_area_suitability_approval_status = approved.
requirements.requiredInputs: System inventory, intended area, and suitability approval evidence
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: Systems for providing reference headings and position fixing shall be suitable for the intended areas.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: ice-information receiver/display and currency properties
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF chapter_9_1_applicable = true, THEN ice_information_receiver_present = true, ice_information_display_present = true, and displayed_ice_information_status = current for the operating area.
requirements.requiredInputs: Applicability, equipment inventory, and time-stamped ice information
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: Ships shall have means of receiving and displaying current information on ice conditions in the area of operation.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: echo-sounding equipment counts and equivalent-device approval
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF ship_ice_strengthened = true AND construction_date >= '2026-01-01', THEN independent_echo_sounding_device_count >= 2 OR (echo_sounding_device_count >= 1 AND independent_transducer_count >= 2) OR administration_approved_equivalent_depth_sounding_device_present = true.
requirements.requiredInputs: Ice-strengthening status, construction date, equipment topology, and equivalent approval
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: Ice-strengthened ships constructed on or after 1 January 2026 shall have either two independent echo-sounding devices or one echo-sounding device with two separate independent transducers. Other devices capable of depth sounding, such as fish finders, acceptable to the Administration, may be used as equivalent means of meeting this requirement.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: SOLAS compliance and equivalent-visibility properties
requirements.normalizedRequirement: SOLAS_V_22_1_9_4_compliance_status = compliant AND clear_view_astern_status = compliant, OR administration_approved_equivalent_visibility_arrangement_present = true.
requirements.requiredInputs: SOLAS/visibility compliance evidence or approved equivalent arrangement
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: Ships shall comply with SOLAS regulation V/22.1.9.4, irrespective of the date of construction and the size, and have a clear view astern. On ships which cannot comply with these requirements, arrangements acceptable to the Administration shall be provided to achieve a level of visibility that is equivalent to these requirements.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: antenna and ice-prevention properties
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF ice_accretion_likely = true, THEN every required navigation or communication antenna shall have ice_accumulation_prevention_means_present = true.
requirements.requiredInputs: Antenna inventory, ice-accretion applicability, and prevention arrangement
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: For ships operating in areas, and during periods, where ice accretion is likely to occur, means to prevent the accumulation of ice on antennas required for navigation and communication shall be provided.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: below-hull sensor and ice-protection properties
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF required_sensor_projects_below_hull = true, THEN sensor_ice_protection_present = true.
requirements.requiredInputs: Required-sensor inventory, projection location, and ice protection
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: Where equipment required by SOLAS chapter V or this chapter have sensors that project below the hull, such sensors shall be protected against ice.

requirements.anchorMapField: iceClass -> reg:iceClass; No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: bridge-wing protection properties
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF ship_category IN {'A','B'} AND construction_date >= '2026-01-01', THEN bridge_wings_enclosed = true OR bridge_wing_protection_design_status = approved OR administration_approved_equivalent_bridge_wing_protection_present = true.
requirements.requiredInputs: Ship category/date and bridge-wing protection/equivalence evidence
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: In category A and B ships constructed on or after 1 January 2026, the bridge wings shall be enclosed or designed to protect navigational equipment and operating personnel. On ships which cannot comply with this regulation, arrangements acceptable to the Administration shall be provided to achieve a level of protection that is equivalent to this regulation.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: gross tonnage and heading-means topology properties
requirements.encodingPattern: Conditional qualified count and topology constraint
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF gross_tonnage >= 500, THEN non_magnetic_heading_means_count >= 2; the means shall be independent and each connected to main_power and emergency_power.
requirements.requiredInputs: Gross tonnage, heading-equipment inventory, independence relation, and power connections
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: Ships of 500 gross tonnage and upwards shall have two non-magnetic means to determine and display their heading. Both means shall be independent and shall be connected to the ship's main and emergency source of power.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: latitude and GNSS compass properties
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF planned_or_actual_latitude_deg > 80, THEN GNSS_compass_or_equivalent_count >= 1 AND connected_to_main_power = true AND connected_to_emergency_power = true.
requirements.requiredInputs: Voyage latitude, compass inventory, and power connections
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: Ships proceeding to latitudes over 80 degrees shall be fitted with at least one GNSS compass or equivalent, which shall be connected to the ship's main and emergency source of power.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: daylight profile and illumination-means count
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF solely_24_hour_daylight_operation = false, THEN visual_ice_detection_illumination_means_count >= 2.
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: Ships, with the exception of those solely operating in areas with 24 hours daylight, shall be equipped with two means of illumination to aid visual detection of ice.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: SOLAS_chapter_I_certified, chapter_11_applicable
requirements.normalizedRequirement: Polar Code chapter 11 applies only when SOLAS_chapter_I_certified = true.
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: This chapter applies to ships certified in accordance with SOLAS chapter I.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: ship particulars and chapter 11-1 applicability
requirements.canonicalVariables: ship_operates_in_polar_waters, ship_type, length_overall_m, gross_tonnage, engaged_in_trade, chapter_11_1_applicable
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF ship_operates_in_polar_waters = true, THEN chapter_11_1_applicable = true when (ship_type = fishing_vessel AND length_overall_m >= 24) OR (ship_type = pleasure_yacht AND gross_tonnage >= 300 AND engaged_in_trade = false) OR (ship_type = cargo_ship AND 300 <= gross_tonnage < 500).
requirements.requiredInputs: Operating area, ship type, length, gross tonnage, and trade status
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: This chapter applies to the following ships operating in polar waters: fishing vessels of 24 metres in length overall and above; pleasure yachts of 300 gross tonnage and upwards not engaged in trade; and cargo ships of 300 gross tonnage and upwards but below 500 gross tonnage.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: chapter 11-1 voyage-plan and hazard-coverage properties
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF chapter_11_1_applicable = true, THEN voyage_plan_present = true and every intended_voyage_hazard shall have voyage_plan_coverage = true.
requirements.requiredInputs: Applicability, voyage plan, and intended-voyage hazard register
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: The voyage plan shall take into account the potential hazards of the intended voyage.

requirements.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: chapter 11-1 planning coverage and documented-procedure properties
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF chapter_11_1_applicable = true, THEN the route planning record shall cover all nine clause 11-1.3 topics; if safety_management_system_implemented = false, documented_polar_operation_procedure_present shall be true.
requirements.requiredInputs: Applicability, safety-management status, procedure artifact, and nine topic indicators
requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.sourceText: The master shall consider a route through polar waters, taking into account the following: the procedures required by the safety management system on board; if no safety management system is implemented there shall be a documented procedure for operation in polar waters; any limitations of the hydrographic information and aids to navigation available; current information on the extent and type of ice and icebergs in the vicinity of the intended route; statistical information on ice and temperatures from former years; places of refuge; current information and measures to be taken when marine mammals are encountered relating to known areas with densities of marine mammals, including seasonal migration areas; current information on relevant ships' routeing systems, speed recommendations and vessel traffic services relating to known areas with densities of marine mammals, including seasonal migration areas; national and international designated protected areas along the route; and operation in areas remote from search and rescue (SAR) capabilities.
